tools.name: get_clinic_info
tools.description: Address, opening hours, phone/WhatsApp, how to get there, technology used and the professional team of Dental Digital Center (dental clinic in Buenos Aires, Argentina). Content in Spanish.

tools.name: list_treatments
tools.description: Lists every dental treatment offered (implants, smile design, veneers, prosthetics, endodontics, whitening, etc.) with a one-line summary and its "from" reference price in ARS.

tools.name: get_treatment
tools.description: Details of one treatment: what it is, "from" reference price in ARS, installment options and a link. Accepts a treatment key or free text such as "implante", "carillas", "blanqueamiento", "limpieza" or "endodoncia". Content in Spanish.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Full list of "from" reference prices in Argentine pesos (ARS) with installment options and the mandatory disclaimer (values are references subject to clinical evaluation, not a quote). Includes the date the prices were last updated.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Frequently asked questions about digital dentistry at the clinic (intraoral scanner, 3D printing, payment, diagnosis). Optional topic filter.

tools.name: how_to_book
tools.description: How a patient can request an appointment: WhatsApp link, phone and contact page. This server cannot create bookings itself.
